meaning: For arbitrary finite rectangular matrix blocks over a commutative ring, positive-power block traces agree and the graded supertrace vanishes. The cubic polynomial follows. The paired-list model explicitly subtracts each weight from itself; it does not derive spectral pairing. B is independent of A and is not proved to be its adjoint. Zero-mode counts are supplied; the rectangular vector may be zero at a=b=0. There is no analytic exponential, ground-state existence proof, or sign-free sampler.
